<template>
  <v-navigation-drawer
    v-model="drawer"
    :rail="!extended"
    permanent
    @click="extended = !extended"
  >
    <v-list>
      <v-list-item @click="extended = !extended">
        <template v-slot:prepend>
          <v-icon>mdi-menu</v-icon>
        </template>
        <v-list-item-title v-if="extended">Menu</v-list-item-title>
      </v-list-item>
    </v-list>

    <v-divider></v-divider>

    <v-list density="compact" nav>
      <v-list-item
        prepend-icon="mdi-database"
        title="Summary"
        value="summary"
        to="/summary"
      ></v-list-item>
    </v-list>

    <v-divider></v-divider>

    <v-list density="compact" nav>
      <v-list-item
        prepend-icon="mdi-view-dashboard"
        title="Dashboard"
        value="dashboard"
        to="/dashboard"
      ></v-list-item>
      <v-list-item
        prepend-icon="mdi-clipboard-check"
        title="Open Positions"
        value="open"
        to="/open-positions"
      ></v-list-item>
      <v-list-item
        prepend-icon="mdi-clipboard-text"
        title="Closed Positions"
        value="closed"
        to="/closed-positions"
      ></v-list-item>
      <v-list-item
        prepend-icon="mdi-swap-horizontal"
        title="Transactions"
        value="transactions"
        to="/transactions"
      ></v-list-item>
    </v-list>

    <v-divider></v-divider>

    <v-list density="compact" nav>
      <v-list-group value="database">
        <template v-slot:activator="{ props }">
          <v-list-item
            v-bind="props"
            prepend-icon="mdi-database"
            title="Database"
          ></v-list-item>
        </template>

        <v-list-item
          prepend-icon="mdi-bank"
          title="Brokers"
          value="brokers"
          to="/database/brokers"
        ></v-list-item>
        <v-list-item
          prepend-icon="mdi-file-document-outline"
          title="Securities"
          value="securities"
          to="/database/securities"
        ></v-list-item>
        <v-list-item
          prepend-icon="mdi-chart-line"
          title="Prices"
          value="prices"
          to="/database/prices"
        ></v-list-item>
      </v-list-group>
    </v-list>

    <template v-slot:append>
      <v-divider></v-divider>
      <v-list density="compact" nav>
        <v-list-item
          prepend-icon="mdi-account-circle"
          title="Profile"
          value="profile"
          to="/profile"
        ></v-list-item>
      </v-list>
    </template>
  </v-navigation-drawer>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  data: () => ({
    drawer: true,
    extended: false,
  }),
}
</script>
